title: Which team will win the second Test of Pakistan's 2026 tour of the West Indies?
background: Pakistan and the West Indies are scheduled to contest a two-match Test cricket series in the Caribbean.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : The official match result published by the ICC or either national cricket board, corroborated by reputable contemporary match reporting. 
  Resolution : Resolve upon completion of the second Test of Pakistan's 2026 tour of the West Indies, using the final result rather than any intermediate match position. 
  Accepted Answer Format : Provide the winning national team's name. If neither team wins, provide the official result classification.
